title: Corpus of Australian and New Zealand Spoken English
citation: Coats, Steven. The Corpus of Australian and New Zealand Spoken English. ALTA 2022.

governance.retention_or_deletion_duties: Do not acquire, retain, upload or process source data while the recorded rights state blocks use.

population.description: Transcribed and time aligned speech from Australian and New Zealand local government video channels.
limitations: Its published terms permit research, education and scholarship only and prohibit redistribution and commercial use, which excludes it from this project. The 2026-07-28 note that it carried no stated licence at all was wrong: the terms exist and they prohibit the use this project would make of it.

Its timings come from forced alignment with an American acoustic model, so its alignment errors would correlate with exactly the Australian and American differences this project needs to measure. It would manufacture the bias it was brought in to detect.
Its audio belongs to hundreds of local councils, so redistribution rights are not the corpus author's to grant.

annotation.provenance: No annotations acquired; the public corpus page was read.
limitations: No source record may enter engineering while access or rights remain blocked.

inspected_materials: The corpus author's public description and terms page, read 2026-07-29.
findings: The stated terms offer the corpus free of charge for research, education and scholarship, and prohibit redistribution and commercial use.
Word tokens carry part of speech tags and timing produced automatically, so this is system output rather than expert annotation in any case.
The two grounds for rejection are independent: either would close the lane on its own.

participant_split.source_split_provenance: No source participant data is acquired or approved.

lineage.duplicate_detection: Required if rights later permit acquisition.
